extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia users/editors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who attempted to view or create a Wikipedia article (here: 'Bill Burr Monday Morning Podcast') explaining why the page may be missing and what steps or requirements apply when creating a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must have an account and meet autoconfirmed status before creating new pages; if you cannot create the page, ensure you're signed in and have the required account standing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are unable or not ready to create a live article, follow the article wizard workflow, submit a draft, or post a request so other editors can assist or review the proposed article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Bill Burr Monday Morning Podcast' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search Wikipedia for variant spellings, alternate titles, or existing coverage to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check what pages link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate backlinks to determine whether the topic is mentioned elsewhere and whether a redirect or merge might be more appropriate than a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be aware of timing/database-update delays
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe you or someone else has just created the page but it isn't appearing, either wait briefly or use the purge function to refresh cached results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (except first character)
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants of the title and, if appropriate, create redirects from common alternative capitalizations to the canonical article title.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page was deleted, check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search the deletion log to determine whether the topic was previously removed and why; use that information to address notability or policy issues before attempting recreation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider adding a redirect to the correct title
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If content exists under a different title, create a redirect from the missing title to the existing article so users searching that name are routed correctly.
